# Channel Actions

The command builder offers multiple channel actions. They allow you to create and manage already created channels. Below you may find some general information about each block. Click on its name for more information.

<table><thead><tr><th data-type="content-ref">Block</th><th>Information</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><a href="/custom-commands-and-events/actions/channel-actions/create-a-channel.md">Create a channel</a></td><td>The create a channel action allows you to create a channel of any type within a Discord server.</td></tr><tr><td><a href="/custom-commands-and-events/actions/channel-actions/edit-a-channel.md">Edit a channel</a></td><td>The edit a channel action allows you to modify an existing channel of any type within a Discord server.</td></tr><tr><td><a href="/custom-commands-and-events/actions/channel-actions/delete-a-channel.md">Delete a channel</a></td><td>The delete a channel action allows you to delete an existing channel of any type within a Discord server.</td></tr></tbody></table>
